about: The model studio (pc/src/studio.cpp): the stage, the camera and the looks. Every number here is data; RPC studio {action: look, set: path, value} changes one, {save: true} keeps the whole file as the user's overlay (pc/user/studio/studio.json, ROOD_STUDIO), which is merged over this one.

window.about: the Studio window: the controls column's share of the window's width (the catalog has the rest)

render.about: The picture's quality while the studio is up. height: lines the renderer works at (the internal resolution is the window's own height or this, whichever is larger, 1 or less: the game's own setting; the picture is scaled to the window), also the lines the GI and its denoiser work at (gi_resolution: pixels of GI to a native line, 0: height / 224); shadow_rays: the sun's shadow rays a pixel (1..8, 0: the settings'; more is a smoother penumbra from the look's sun.angle); aa: rood-studio's anti-aliasing as the setting's text ("smaa", "msaa4+smaa"; empty: the settings'; the internal resolution is 5x the game's, so SMAA is enough and MSAA's resolve left dark dots along the stage's triangle edges where the sun's shadow is lit); widescreen: rood-studio's picture is 16:9 in a window wider than 3:2, else 4:3 (the game's own); window_width, window_height: rood-studio's window when ROOD_WINDOW is not set. The in-game studio takes height and gi_resolution too.

camera.about_yaw: degrees from the model's front (0: face on, 180: from behind), added to its facing; weapons use weapon_yaw: the flat of the blade to the camera

animation.about: holds: the script's bone holds apply. handover: an animation that hands over (its script starts another: the game's commands 2 and 19 to 24) plays on into the next, mapped as the game maps it by the actor's state (weapon_drawn: the studio's actor holds its weapon out, as in the game's studio; stance_a5, stance_a0_3, stance_a6: the actor's stance flags unkA_5, unkA_0 = 3 and unkA_6, which the decomp leaves unnamed; off, as in the game's studio) with the blend of the old pose into the new; event_playback: the game is in its event-playback phase (the game's studio is: a handover always starts the next animation; off, one to the same table and record starts nothing); collision_radius: the actor's collision radius (0x80 and over, a large actor: its blends take twice the frames); action_done: command 2's condition, the action's hits are done (the game's func_8006C84C returns 0), so it goes on to the idle animation; tickspeed: the game's update spacing (2 the normal; 4 its slow tick, which doubles the frames an update plays and the steps a blend takes). smooth: the pose is shown at the time between the game's steps (the two steps around it, each bone's rotation slerped, scales and places linear; whole steps are exactly the game's); off, the game's own steps. smooth_blend: the frames a change of animation fades the shown pose into the new animation's over (0: a cut).

turntable.about: Automatic rotation, either or both. model: the model itself turns (the light moves across its surface); light: the key light's yaw goes round the model. Degrees a second, negative the other way. paused holds the angles; fixed_dt (seconds, 0: real time) gives each render a fixed step, for tests.

locate.about: The texel locator (Aseprite <-> studio). marker: where the texel the painter points at (Aseprite's cursor, or RPC studio locate) lands on the model: the texel's footprint on each triangle that samples it (filled, outlined) and a ring at its centre; colour r,g,b 0..255, alphas 0..1, sizes in window pixels, pulse_hz 0 = steady, back_alpha = how much of it shows where the surface faces away or is hidden. pick: the texel under the studio's own cursor. pick_on: hover (every texel the cursor crosses is sent to Aseprite) | click | off; click_scrolls: a click also scrolls Aseprite's view to the texel (hover only selects it).

backdrop.about: stage: the stage; solid: no stage (no floor, wall or drop shadow), the model on one colour (r, g, b 0..255) drawn as the game's own background, not lit.

neutral.about: A key light and a flat sky: the model read in clean light. The room's own lights, glows, haze and fog are off.

flat.about: Ambient light only, from every side alike: the model's colour with no shading to read it by.
